statement: let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → h a b ≤ (1+ε)*r a b+C

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 全局高度与 abc · JA-0065 · 对每个 ε 证明统一的有理 abc 不等式
plain_statement.en: New route · Global heights and abc · JA-0065 · Prove a uniform rational abc inequality for every ε

brief.zh: 常数只依赖 ε，每一互素正整数对都需满足同一界。
brief.en: The constant depends only on ε and must work for every coprime pair of positive integers.
